test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ABOVE' is written as '9' and 'SHINE' is written as '11'. How will 'PARTY' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/feeb3453e20556929458bc0f21654ff1e928169c56fca1c1854f4b639d2483f2.png] 

**Logic: Code = [(Addition of all letter's position value) ÷ (number of letters)]**

'ABOVE' is written as '9' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749c9a6a673419449741df3d22755e0ae9ead69d3c64491f9e215fdb6f5c3d73.png] 

'SHINE' is written as '11' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7869fdeec2507cc149bcff3f04909bc3c974d944bf7ae1922bbd3982e415e9b5.png] 

Similarly, 'PARTY" will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7aed9520b283c512b64912a809b02a41d3cb9d43c9d47d741808a3bdb8bb974a.png] 

Here, 'PARTY' is written as '**16'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
